title: Generate SLSA provenance attestation for build artefacts
current: CI runs typecheck, lint, test, build, audit, and secret scan. No SBOM is generated and no SLSA provenance attestation is produced for the build output.
proposed: Add a new step to the `verify` job in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` after the Build step: `uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@v2` (pin to SHA). Also add `id-token: write` and `attestations: write` to that job's permissions block. This produces a signed SLSA provenance attestation attached to the workflow run, satisfying SLSA L2 for the build artefact.

Upload results to GitHub's code-scanning dashboard via the SARIF upload step. Surface the Scorecard badge in README.md.

title: Add pre-install lockfile tamper-detection step to CI
current: `npm ci` is used (which validates lockfile integrity hashes at install time), and `npm audit signatures` runs post-install. No explicit step documents or enforces that the lockfile itself has not been modified outside of `npm install` commands.
proposed: Add a CI step in `verify` job (before `npm ci`) that runs `git diff --exit-code package-lock.json` to assert the lockfile was not modified in the working tree after checkout. Add a rule to `40-tooling-supply-chain.mdc` stating that `package-lock.json` must never be hand-edited and that the CI pre-install diff check enforces this. This is a one-line shell step with zero new dependencies.

title: Add SLSA attestation verification step to CI and deployment docs
current: Build provenance attestation is generated via `actions/attest-build-provenance` on push to main. No verification step exists in CI or in the deployment guidance in `62-deployment-observability.mdc`.
proposed: Add a `deploy` job (or a post-build verification step in the `verify` job) that runs `gh attestation verify dist/ --owner <org>` using the GitHub CLI (pre-installed on `ubuntu-latest`). Document the verification command in `62-deployment-observability.mdc` under a new 'Artefact integrity' section so that consumers of the built output know how to verify before deploying.
